name: Form 4 Mathematics Term 1 Exam
subject: Mathematics
instructions: Answer ALL questions. Show all working. Mathematical tables may be used.

items.question: The value of cos(90 degrees) is?
The matrix product of [[1,0],[0,1]] and [[2,3],[4,5]] is?

sections.heading: Section B: Written Questions (96 marks)
items: 1. Differentiate y = 3x^3 - 4x^2 + 5x - 7 with respect to x. (4 marks)
2. Find the stationary point of the curve y = x^2 - 6x + 5 and state its nature. (6 marks)
3. Solve the equation: 2cos x - 1 = 0 for 0 <= x <= 360. (4 marks)
4. Using the triangle in the diagram, find the value of tan A. (4 marks)
5. Calculate the mean and standard deviation of 2, 4, 6, 8, 10. (6 marks)
6. A bag contains 5 red and 3 white balls. Two balls are drawn without replacement. Find the probability that both are red. (4 marks)
7. Solve the simultaneous equations using matrices: 2x + y = 7, x - y = 2 (6 marks)
